name: TOB Sunday School Weekly Quiz
description: A lightweight, standalone weekly quiz for Sunday School students — deliberately NOT an LMS Quiz (that doctype requires a course and a qtt_platform tenant, the wrong shape for an informal weekly quiz). quiz_type distinguishes the mockup's "Weekly Bible Quiz" from "Faith Leader Exam" — same mechanic (marks convert to points, top-3 shown on a podium), so one doctype instead of two duplicates. Questions live in TOB Sunday School Weekly Quiz Question, a separate top-level doctype.

fields.label: Quiz Type
fields.options:
Weekly Bible Quiz
Faith Leader Exam

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Draft = admin still building it. Published = students can take it. Closed = finalize_quiz() has graded/ranked every attempt and awarded points; no more submissions accepted.

fields.label: Week Start
fields.description: Monday of the week this quiz is for.

fields.label: Total Marks
fields.description: Sum of every question's marks — kept in sync manually by the admin editor, same convention as TOB Reading Plan.duration_days.
